"''Oh, ''yeah''— Jenny from Mos Espa!|Jenny and Han Solo|}} '''Jenny''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] from [[Mos Espa]], on the [[desert]] [[planet]] of [[Tatooine]]. In [[1 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' she worked as a B-girl at [[Chalmun]]'s [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina|Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]].[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] She flirted with [[Han Solo]], a [[Corellian]] [[smuggler]] who had a woman in every [[spaceport]], on the occasions when he stopped on Tatooine. One [[Standard day|day]], Jenny came to sit on the smuggler's lap while he was awaiting news from [[Taggart (smuggler)|Taggart]] about a cargo of [[glitterstim]] [[spice]]. From their booth, the two witnessed a bar brawl during which an [[Obi-Wan Kenobi|old man]] whipped a [[lightsaber]] at an [[Aqualish]] [[Ponda Baba|pirate]] to defend his young [[Luke Skywalker|protégé]]. When Solo's [[First Mate|first mate]], the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]], joined them in their booth, Jenny realized that the Corellian did not even remember her name, conflating her with another of his female conquests. Offended, she threw the remainder of the man's drink in his face and stormed off. Whilst she was in the cantina, she sat and spoke with a [[Rodian]]. ==Behind the scenes== Jenny first appeared in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], in which she was portrayed by [[Jenny Cresswell]]. Although her scene with Han Solo did not make the final cut of the film, she can still be seen talking to a Rodian in the cantina in widescreen releases of the film. Although Cresswell's character had dark hair, Jenny is described as having pale hair in ''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]''. This article assumes that her brief film appearance shows her correct hair color. ==Appearances== *{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} *''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]'' {{Ab|A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy (audiobook)}} ==Sources== *[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] *''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes IV–VI, 1977–1983]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ჯენი }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Tatooinians]]
